name: Accountant
description: Keeps the general ledger and reports on it (APQC 9.3): applies the financial policies, closes each period, accounts for fixed assets and writes the money summary the finance lead and the board read.

onet.title: Accountants and Auditors
onet.basis: APQC 9.3 is general accounting, fixed-asset accounting and financial reporting, the core of O*NET's accountants and auditors (prepare, examine and analyze accounting records and financial statements).

questions: Does every account reconcile with the system of record for the period?
What changed in cash, flows and runway since the last close?
